elements.element: Customer owns all deliverables created for Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause does not address deliverables generally. It allocates to Client only results and work product of the Support Services.

elements.element: Customer owns all work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Client retains rights in work product of the Support Services, but the language does not cover all work product created for Client under the Agreement.

elements.element: Vendor assigns to Customer all right, title and interest in the deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: No present assignment or obligation to assign appears. Saying Client 'retains' rights does not supply the required Vendor assignment mechanism.

elements.element: Vendor retains ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no reservation of ownership for TrueLink's pre-existing intellectual property.

elements.element: Vendor grants Customer a licence to any Vendor pre-existing intellectual property embedded in the deliverables.
elements.evidence: No embedded-IP licence is granted, and the clause does not demonstrate that no Vendor pre-existing IP will be embedded.

elements.element: The licence to embedded Vendor pre-existing intellectual property is perpetual.
elements.evidence: There is no embedded-IP licence and no perpetual duration.

elements.element: The licence to embedded Vendor pre-existing intellectual property is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: There is no embedded-IP licence and no irrevocability language.

elements.element: The licence to embedded Vendor pre-existing intellectual property is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: There is no embedded-IP licence and no royalty-free term.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: As between the parties, Client expressly retains all right, title and interest in Credit Data and all borrower and loan data, which are the relevant Customer Data categories in this clause.

elements.element: There is no joint ownership between Customer and Vendor.
elements.evidence: The clause does not expressly disclaim joint ownership, and its ownership allocation does not comprehensively address deliverables, Vendor IP or other work product outside the Support Services.

elements.element: Vendor owns its generic tools.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no ownership reservation for TrueLink's generic tools.

elements.element: Vendor owns its know-how.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no ownership reservation for TrueLink's know-how.

elements.element: Customer receives a licence to all deliverables.
elements.evidence: No licence to deliverables is granted; the clause instead states limited ownership language for Support Services results and work product.

elements.element: The licence to deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: No deliverables licence or perpetual duration is stated.

elements.element: The licence to deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: No deliverables licence or irrevocability language is stated.

elements.element: The licence to deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: No deliverables licence or worldwide scope is stated.

elements.element: The licence to deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: No deliverables licence or royalty-free term is stated.

elements.element: The licence permits Customer to use the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The clause does not expressly grant Client a right to use deliverables.

elements.element: The licence permits Customer to modify the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The clause does not expressly grant Client a right to modify deliverables.

elements.element: The licence permits Customer to sublicense the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The clause does not expressly grant Client a right to sublicense deliverables.

elements.element: The licence permits Customer to exercise the licensed rights for its business.
elements.evidence: No deliverables licence or business-use scope is stated.

result.reason: The redline effectively narrows TrueLink's rights in Credit Data and preserves Client ownership of relevant data, but it does not establish a complete deliverables ownership regime. It omits a Vendor assignment, the Vendor pre-existing-IP reservation and embedded-IP licence, a no-joint-ownership provision, and every required component of the fallback deliverables licence. The use of 'retains' for newly created Support Services work product is also weaker and less precise than a present assignment.
